in_marathi.name: Babusona
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Babusona हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘babhu’ (lord) and ‘sona’ (gold), Babusona is a name that invokes prosperity, fortune, and abundance. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the deity Ganesha, the god of wisdom and wealth, bestows his blessings upon those named after him.
